children: Overview
Authentication tech firm's Q3 revenue rose 12% yr/yr, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company raised midpoint of full-year adjusted EPS guidance and narrowed the range
Outlook
Crane NXT raises midpoint of 2026 adj EPS guidance to $4.32-$4.42
Company now sees 2026 sales growth at ~14%, down from prior +15% to +17%
SAT segment sales growth forecast at ~11%, DTT segment at high-teens for 2026
Result Drivers
CUSTOMER WINS - Co said long-term customer contracts contributed to Q3 performance, per CEO Aaron Saak
ACQUISITIONS - Acquisitions accounted for most of Q3 sales growth, with organic growth remaining modest
FREE CASH FLOW - Strong free cash flow generation cited as supporting financial flexibility and deleveraging, per CEO Aaron Saak
